english: Saint Mont Blanc Academy... I wonder\nwhat's in Eve's lab?
The lab holds a vast\ncollection of research.
It's full of research results.\nMuch of it things\nno human but the teacher knows.
You're looking down.\nStill in shock, huh?
Of course. She was like family, right?
Yeah... but if I don't save [MERU],\nthe teacher's efforts go to waste, and\nI can't afford to mope right now!
Yes... but the teacher would say\nto act now.\nI can't let it get me down!
That's the spirit! Let's hurry on!
Saint Mont Blanc Academy is\nfar from Polyal, right?
We walked quite a distance last time too.\nCame out along the coast, remember.
Last time we had a carefree swim in the sea,\nbut this time I'm in no mood for that, nyo.
Even Dejiko\ncan't stay carefree, huh...
Being downhearted won't help, though.
Right. Let's move, quickly!
Hm! Right on cue!
That signal — it's Kei!
Eve's research results: mine.\nNo interference. Annihilate here.
So you're after the same thing!
Kei... you killed my teacher...!!
That black monster\nsurpasses my combat capabilities.\nIts full-power combat capability: incalculable.
Besides Mie, there is another who surpassed me.\nI must gather data urgently.
Gather... data...
Is something wrong, [CLAUDE]?
No, it's nothing.
Eve concealed data on the black monster.\nAs a result, she lost her life.\nA foolish human.
'Foolish'...?
Had I shot that woman instead of Eve that time,\nwhat would have happened?
Would she still have awakened?\nOr would a life simply have been lost?
You're trying to piss us off!?
Unable to comprehend.\nI merely considered the possibilities.
This one's not just a machine on the outside —\nshe's a machine through and through...!
Good thing Hibiki isn't here.\nI could never see eye to eye with this thing!
(I... know what Kei is.\nAnd I know the truth of the world\nthat awakens the 'Goddess of Destruction'...)
(What... should I do...?)
Eve saved my life once...\nI'll have her revenge!
Probability that Tsubasa Kazanari's combat power\nsurpasses mine: 0%.
I don't know what you're calculating,\nbut you can't measure my rage\nor the power of the Symphogear!
You challenge me with such an outdated model?
That 'newer is always better' thinking —\nnot a fan.
It is a fact that newer things are superior.
Poor thing. Don't you ever think\nabout when YOU become\nthe outdated model?
Me, outdated? Unable to comprehend. Impossible.
You're missing something.\nImagination!
Damage to all sections, safety level exceeded.\nCombat mode disengaged. Retreat! Retreat!
Error in enemy combat data!\nSignificant combat power increase confirmed.\nCause: unknown. Unable to comprehend!
Like a machine like you could understand!\nOur rage!!
Can't you even understand\nwhat we think of you right now?
Unable to comprehend... No equipment changes detected.\nWhy, in such a short time, such a\npower-up...?
A machine doll like you wouldn't understand.\nHuman strength isn't decided\nby equipment alone.
Humans gain experience and grow.\nThrough battles against you, the black-clad lot, and Eve,\nwe have been honed.
Scanning... The values should be\nno different from before...?
Neither experience nor growth can be measured in numbers.
Not being swayed by fleeting power.\nCasting aside doubt, steeling your resolve.\nAnd answering the feelings entrusted to you.
The unseen is what changes people.\nIsn't that right, Rika?
Yes, that is right.
(...I've grown too, it seems.)
Unable to comprehend... unable to measure... unable to analyze...!
Huh, even machines panic.\nWell-made, aren't you.
Withdrawing from the front!
She's gone...
She won't attack for a while.\nTo Saint Mont Blanc Academy, while we can!
Let's get going, quick!
[MERU]'s waiting for us.
[NOEL]'s waiting.
//END
